after: In an invented comparison using 100 identified live cells per formulation at the same measurement time, A shows uptake in 70 cells and encoded protein in 10; B shows uptake in 40 and protein in 25. Uptake is therefore 70 versus 40 per cent, while protein expression is 10 versus 25 per cent on the same live-cell denominator. These separate counts do not show which cells had both signals, the fraction of intact RNA that escaped, the amount of protein per cell or a biological effect. Name the cargo, cell population, assay, timing and controls before comparing formulations; a brighter carrier signal alone does not establish usable RNA delivery.
